summary: Recommends dynamic inventory for clouds and other systems with canonical host lists, and using tags to separate production from staging.
questions: Should I maintain a static inventory for cloud servers?
How do I separate prod and staging cloud instances in inventory?

answer_card.title: Use dynamic inventory for clouds
answer_card.answer_md: When a cloud provider or other system keeps the canonical list of your infrastructure, use **dynamic inventory** instead of hand-editing static files. Use cloud tags to distinguish production from staging.
